slides.kicker: For coaches who sell in the DMs
slides.title: This page is for you if your *DMs* are where your sales happen, and you can't keep up.
slides.sub: Read the list, then tell me how many you checked.

slides.title: You'll feel right at home here if
items: A Reel worked, and now you have more DMs than you can handle.
You answer leads from the couch at 11:47 pm, because that's when you finally have time.
Someone asked "how much?", you answered, and they disappeared.
You have a notes app full of replies you copy and paste.
You tried a setter or a keyword flow, and it never sounded like you.

slides.title: The real *DM life* of people who sell on a call.
slides.body: Every week: the replies that book calls, the ones that lose leads, and the little things coaches do to keep up. No hype, no income screenshots.

slides.title: We read a lot of DMs, and we build for the part after the first one.
slides.body: ManySetter is an AI setter for Manychat: it qualifies inbound Instagram, WhatsApp and Facebook Messenger conversations inside your existing flows, then books a call or hands the lead to your team. Keep your Manychat, add the setter.

slides.title: So, how many did you *check* out of 5?
slides.body: Tell me your number in the comments. If it's 4 or 5, you can build your setter for free and test it before it ever talks to a lead.
